content.value_statement: Publishing work can stop when account limits are unclear. This skill explains your BulkPublish plan limits and current resource usage.
actual_capabilities: Lists Free, Pro, and Business limits for publishing resources.
Clarifies that a limit value of -1 means unlimited.
Points to the BulkPublish billing settings location.
limitations: It documents quota information but does not retrieve account data itself.
It cannot change a subscription or increase plan limits.
Plan limits may change outside this skill documentation.
It does not estimate future usage or billing costs.

output_examples.input: What does -1 mean in a quota limit?
output_examples.output: A limit of -1 means that resource is unlimited for the current plan.
Daily BulkPublish limits reset at midnight UTC.
No. Storage is cumulative, so deleting old media can free available storage.

best_practices: Compare each usage value with its matching resource limit.
Use UTC when planning work near the daily reset time.
Review cumulative storage before uploading large media files.
anti_patterns: Do not treat -1 as a missing or zero limit.
Do not assume daily and monthly limits reset at the same time.
Do not rely on this reference to change account settings.

faq.question: What does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It documents BulkPublish plan limits, usage fields, resets, and billing settings.

faq.question: Does this skill fetch my account usage?
faq.answer: No. It explains the get_quota_usage response and documented limits.

faq.question: What does -1 mean in limits?
faq.answer: It means the resource is unlimited for the plan.

faq.question: When do daily limits reset?
faq.answer: Daily limits reset at midnight UTC.

faq.question: Can this skill upgrade my plan?
faq.answer: No. It directs you to app.bulkpublish.com/settings/billing for subscription changes.

faq.question: How can I free storage?
faq.answer: Delete old media using delete_media to reduce cumulative storage usage.
